title: The Signal of Station Meridian
author: E. M. Joubert
blurb: Sebastian Coldharbour, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
